column7: SCIM ReplaceUser/PatchUser/DeleteUser (and GetUser) answered every core error 404, CreateUser 400: an IdP told 404 for a rolled-back deactivation or DELETE stops retrying and the account stays active. Errors are now classified by sentinel (writeSCIMWriteError): 404 only for absent/not-SCIM-managed, storage failures 500, contention 503 + Retry-After
